title: NRF Big Show 2027 travel and attendee guide
body_markdown:
NRF 2027: Retail’s Big Show runs January 10–12, 2027, at the Jacob K. Javits Convention Center in New York City. NRF describes the annual event as bringing together more than 41,000 retail professionals, with 175-plus sessions and more than 1,000 industry partners, so the show can feel less like one conference and more like a temporary city built around retail.\[1\]


Whether you are comparing retail technology or meeting industry peers, the travel arrangements should allow you time to get what you need from the show. This guide covers where to stay, how to get there, what to budget, and how to fit sessions, demos, and dinners into your visit.


### Key Takeaways


- NRF 2027 takes place Sunday through Tuesday, January 10–12. The current agenda also lists an opening party at the Marriott Marquis on Saturday evening, January 9.\[1\]\[3\]
- A Hudson Yards hotel may make it easier to get to Javits, depending on the property and entrance. The Penn Station area might be better if you’re arrival by rail, while Times Square may appeal if Saturday’s Marriott Marquis opening party is a part of your plans.\[3\]
- NRF’s official onPeak room block includes a contracted rate guarantee through December 15, 2026, plus a shuttle from official hotels outside walking distance.\[4\]
- For January 2027, the federal New York City benchmark is $189 for lodging and $92 for meals and incidental expenses, or $281 before lodging taxes.\[8\]
- [Navan Edge](https://navan.com/product/navan-edge) can search and book your flights, hotel, and restaurant reservations in one chat, with support available 24/7.


## What is NRF Big Show and who is it for?


Retail’s Big Show is the National Retail Federation’s annual gathering for retail professionals exploring the technology and trends shaping the industry. NRF expects an audience of retail peers, brands, vendors, and experts, with product demos and hands-on experiences happening alongside the conference program.\[1\]\[2\]


For a retail professional evaluating technology, the in-person advantage is being able to compare more quickly — the same customer journey, inventory exception, fulfillment problem, or loyalty use case can be put to several vendors in one day. Peers and experts you meet along the way also add context that is hard to reproduce in a generic product call.


The trip tends to be most valuable when tied to a live decision, such as narrowing a commerce stack, pressure-testing an AI use case, reviewing store systems, or meeting peers who have worked through the same problem. That question gives the week a center without derailing your focus.

NRF has announced onPeak as its official housing provider. The block offers a contracted best-rate guarantee through December 15, 2026, cancellation and relocation protections, and complimentary Javits shuttles from official hotels outside walking distance.\[4\] While it’s a useful comparison point, you should still weigh up total price, cancellation terms, and the specific route to the conference — our[hotels near the Javits Center guide](https://navan.com/hotel-choices/javits-center) can help.


According to Navan data, business hotel bookings in the Javits and Hudson Yards area during the same period in 2026 had a median nightly total of $372, including taxes and fees. We can’t explicitly identify these guests as NRF attendees, so treat this as historical context rather than a forecast for 2027.


## Flights to NRF 2027


If attending Sunday morning sessions is a priority, arriving Saturday allows room for a relaxed check-in and the opportunity to attend the opening party. Someone coming mainly for Monday meetings may prefer a shorter stay, provided the journey leaves enough time before the first commitment. Whether you arrive by air or rail, remember the hotel transfer as part of your journey comparison.

## How to set a budget for NRF 2027


An NRF budget likely needs more than the pass, airfare, and room. Consider that you might also need to account for:


- Lodging taxes
- Airport transfers
- Local transport
- Uncovered meals/client dinners
- Extra baggage, and booth materials.


For January 2027, the federal New York City benchmark is $189 a night for lodging before tax and $92 a day for meals and incidental expenses.\[8\]\[9\] These are federal reimbursement rates; your employer may set different limits.\[10\]

You may find it easier to build each day around the sessions, demos, and conversations that matter most to you. Some space between them gives you time to move between floors, stay longer with a useful discussion, or explore a booth you had not planned to visit.


## What to pack for NRF 2027


January in New York can mean cold outdoor walks between warm indoor spaces. Keep an eye on the weather forecast, but for outdoor walking and long indoor days, a warm coat, removable layer, weather-resistant shoes, and comfortable socks should cover the basics.


A compact umbrella, portable battery, refillable bottle, and comfortable note taking system are also useful. If you plan on attending a more formal event or diner, pack a polished layer, too.

Some things to consider when arranging your airport transfer:


- Javits states the 7 subway extension is across the street from the venue.\[6\]
- A car might be more suitable for a group booking than public transport, or if you’re carrying bulky booth materials
- Transit service can change, so the route is worth checking again on your travel day.


## How to make the most of the NRF expo


With more than 1,000 industry partners, it can be easy to lose focus. Establishing a business question you want answered, followed by a small set of vendors that each approach it differently, can be a solid base to a productive conference.


If you are comparing products, asking vendors to show the same situation can make their differences easier to see. For customer experience tools, that might be a return or a store-to-digital journey; for supply-chain software, an out-of-stock item. You can then compare how each product handles the problem and ask about anything the demonstration leaves unclear.


If there is someone you especially want to meet, reaching out a week or two ahead gives you a chance to arrange a conversation. A specific question — perhaps about an integration or a challenge you share, gives you both somewhere to start. The same goes for a follow-up after the conference. Specifically referring to what you discussed will feel more personal than a generic post-show email.


## Where to eat near the Javits Center


After a long day at Javits, these options offer different settings for a client conversation or team meal. If you are bringing a group, it is worth checking menus, accessibility, minimum spend, and cancellation terms in advance. Here are some local recommendations:


- **Client or executive dinner — Ci Siamo:** At 440 West 33rd Street in Manhattan West, Ci Siamo offers live-fire Italian cooking, homemade pasta, a private bar, and private dining near Javits.\[14\]
- **Flexible team or partner meal — Mercado Little Spain:** A short walk from Javits in Hudson Yards, Mercado Little Spain has several restaurants, a market setting, and private or semi-private formats. La Barra accepts direct group-dining bookings for 9–20 guests.\[15\]
- **Small high-stakes dinner — Peak:** Peak’s Sky Cellar at 30 Hudson Yards seats up to 18 around one table. The venue says availability is confirmed 30 days before the event because larger buyouts may take precedence, so it works best when that uncertainty is acceptable.\[16\]

## Wrapping up NRF 2007


Tuesday’s 4 p.m. expo close might leave time for unresolved demos or conversations, but if you’re departing that same evening there might not be time once check-out, traffic, and the airport transfer are added.


A little time to compare notes with your team can help you decide which products deserve a closer look and which questions still need answers. Following up with the people you met while the conversations are fresh also gives you an easier starting point once your everyday work resumes, and share insights with your teams back home as soon as possible, while ideas and insights are still top of mind.
